name: io.github.tonyyang0504/dv360-mcp
description: Google Display & Video 360 (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool maps t

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client id of a Google Cloud project with the Display & Video 360 API enabled.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The OAuth client's secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from Google's consent flow with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/display-video, for a user with a DV360 user profile (Admin/Standard for writes).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_PARTNER_ID
environmentVariables.description: DV360 partner id whose advertisers list_accounts returns (GET /v4/advertisers requires partnerId).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: DV360 advertiser id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /v4/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns/{campaignId}).
